name: Pinecone
summary: Pinecone is a fully managed vector database offered as a serverless service. It stores dense and sparse vectors with metadata, adds full-text search (GA in September 2026), and hosts embedding and reranking models behind the same API. Plans range from a free tier to enterprise and BYOC deployments.
facts: Managed serverless; BYOC in your own cloud account
Dense, sparse and full-text (BM25) in one index
Free Starter; Standard from $50/mo minimum; Enterprise $500/mo
goodFor: Teams that want no database operations
Integrated embedding, rerank and search in one API
watchOut: Closed source; Pinecone Local emulator reached end of life in Oct 2026
Costs scale with read and write units, which vary by region
Free tier limited to one AWS region
